title: RISC-V Is Inevitable: State of the Union Keynote Argues
summary: This EE Times article covers a keynote presentation on the state of RISC-V, arguing that the open-source instruction set architecture is becoming inevitable in the semiconductor industry. The article discusses RISC-V's trajectory from an academic project to a mainstream alternative to proprietary architectures like ARM and x86.
problem_solved: Addresses the industry challenge of reducing dependency on proprietary instruction set architectures and enabling more flexible, royalty-free processor designs.
why_valuable: Provides strategic insights into the future of processor architecture adoption, which is critical for semiconductor companies, embedded systems developers, and technology investors planning long-term roadmaps.
